_readme: Art packs — the artwork you sell, as opposed to the tools you sell (those live in products.json). Drop a pack into the `packs` array below and it shows up in the store AND in the sticker sheet builder's art tray, so a customer can buy a pack and immediately build a sheet with it. `art` is a list of image URLs (Supabase storage, your CDN, anywhere public). `price` is in whole dollars. Either paste a Stripe Payment Link into `paymentLink`, or leave it null and set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY in Netlify.
